definitions.CAC: Recorded acquisition cost / first-paid customers. These are attribution/accounting ratios, not incremental CAC. Organic segment CAC is unsupported, not zero.
definitions.acquisition: First positive successful payment; an initial payment remains an acquisition if later refunded. CRM creation is not acquisition.
definitions.acquisition_cost: Recorded media plus campaign-specific creative/vendor acquisition costs. Discounts reduce transaction revenue and are not counted again as acquisition spending.
definitions.attribution: One credited ordinary campaign within the acquisition month. Source credit is not a causal label.
definitions.business: Studio North is a fictional monthly creative-work membership for independent professionals. Members use ready-to-use templates to save time or guided learning to build skills; standard ($50) and premium ($75) subscriptions can renew monthly, with optional paid workshops/add-ons.
definitions.channel_holdouts: Separate, disjoint acquisition-only pilot sample. One row per randomized arm; all assigned prospects, buyers through every route, and focal acquisition spend. No customer-level linkage, revenue, retention or lifetime outcomes. Never join pilot counts or costs into cohort accounting or model fitting.
definitions.cohort: Calendar month of the first paid transaction. cohort_index and age_month are zero-based; age 0 is the acquisition month.
definitions.company_scope: The operational cohort panel and its recorded acquisition spending. The separate acquisition-only pilot sample and pilot budget are outside this panel.
definitions.contribution: Net revenue minus incurred variable_cost, before acquisition spending and fixed costs. Refund rows do not duplicate original service costs.
definitions.forecast: Separate observed cash contribution from model forecasts. A 12-month horizon and 1% monthly discount use first receipt t=age_month+1; cash payback is undiscounted.
definitions.gross_payment_revenue: Sum gross_amount minus discount_amount on successful payment rows, before refunds; positive for every retained person-month. Net revenue equals this payment revenue minus refunds.
definitions.net_revenue: gross_amount minus discount_amount minus refund_amount, summed over the dated financial ledger.
definitions.paying: At least one payment event in the calendar month; count people and distinct paid orders, not refund ledger rows.
definitions.retention: Paid scheduled subscription cycle. One subscription per person; membership is monotone until cancellation/failure, with no reactivation.
definitions.targeting: Every paid campaign targets one baseline primary_need. Direct segment cost aggregation is supported for primary_need, not age_band or region.
definitions.time: UTC. data_as_of is exclusive. Monthly period statuses are known at renewal. Future pending periods are scheduling records, not observed retention.
definitions.usage: Observed core_action events. A retained subscriber can have no core_action event; usage and membership are different measures.

acquisition_attribution.csv.grain: One acquired person and the recorded credit for the first successful payment.

campaign_spend.csv.grain: One campaign per spending date; aggregate before joining to customer outcomes.

channel_holdouts.csv.grain: One arm per channel acquisition test in a separate pilot sample; all assigned prospects remain in the counts.

feedback.csv.grain: One completed linked survey response; nonresponse is missing, not a zero rating.

people.csv.grain: One person in the operational customer-history panel.

product_events.csv.grain: One observed product/support interaction; no event does not mean no subscription.

subscription_periods.csv.grain: One scheduled monthly cycle; a paid outcome establishes retained membership for that cycle.

transactions.csv.grain: One payment or refund event; each payment is one order and refunds reuse its order ID.
